news.title: Get More from World of Warcraft with the WoW Celebration Pass
news.summary: As a thank you for the incredible launch of WoW Forever, we’re offering a limited time discount for a full year of game time. Players can purchase the WoW Celebration Pass and open the portal to adventure in every version of the game, including the newly released World of Warcraft: Forever.

news.title: Twitch Drop: Get the Cuddly Seafoam Grrgle Housing Decor Item December 1!
news.summary: Watch 4 hours of any eligible World of Warcraft stream on Twitch.tv from December 1 at 10:00 am PST until December 29 at 10:00 am PST to claim the Cuddly Seafoam Grrgle Housing decor item.

news.title: Talebound’s Twisted Tales Arrive December 1
news.summary: Step into the macabre world of Talebound, where you become part of the dark chronicles of a mysterious Storyteller, chillingly brought to life.

news.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Now Live!
news.summary: Begin your first adventure or return to a new and reimagined Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever, now live worldwide. Adventure to level 60 across the original continents, discover new stories, and meet fellow adventurers in a permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW where community comes first and the journey matters as much as the destination.

news.title: Unlock a Year of World of Warcraft®
news.summary: Claim a 12-Month Subscription and get bonus in-game cosmetic items, including several for use in World of Warcraft: Forever!

news.title: Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades
news.summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Prurchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

forever.collectionLine: Warcraft Forever Collection will be available through January 11, 2027.

events.title: World of Warcraft Live Q&A
events.desc: Live Q&A with the WoW development team on BlizzCon 2026 reveals, 10:00 a.m. PDT on the official Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels.
